decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize combo pieces such as Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill your opponent's library, while also controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur key artifacts from the graveyard, and cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and utility. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Lotus Petal for ramp and card draw, with Urza's Saga providing additional value. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game tempo while being aggressive with efficient threats. It utilizes disruption spells such as Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having access to countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The creatures in the deck are either resilient or provide value when they enter the battlefield, such as Brazen Borrower and Baleful Strix. The deck also has a land disruption package with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and removal spells while deploying efficient threats to pressure the opponent. By combining a mixture of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying evasive threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to win the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student acts as card advantage engine and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional disruption and removal. Overall, the deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent effectively to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on combining the cards Grindstone and Painter's Servant to mill out the opponent's library, while using Goblin Engineer to find the necessary pieces. It also includes disruptive elements like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo, alongside burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through the combo, utilizing cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide for explosive plays. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Ancient Tomb and Urza's Saga for additional advantage and consistency.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive elements such as Thoughtseize and Skyclave Apparition to control the opponent's board while using Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic to quickly put threats on the battlefield. With the help of cards like Solitude, Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game swiftly. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value through blinking creatures and gaining card advantage. The deck also includes powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat to further enhance its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's graveyard while also utilizing various combo pieces to quickly win the game. The goal is to control the game with cards like Leyline of the Void and Thoughtseize, while setting up the Helm of Obedience combo to exile the opponent's entire library. Dauthi Voidwalker and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional graveyard disruption, while Dark Ritual allows for explosive plays. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to handle threats. With careful planning and execution, this deck aims to dominate the opponent and secure a victory.

The main concept of this Legacy deck is to utilize the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. By using cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to search for and recur key pieces of the combo, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary cards to win the game. Additional cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast provide disruption against opposing spells while fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide help accelerate the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on efficiently executing its combo win condition while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Combo - Show and Tell Legacy deck is to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes a number of countermagic spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect your combo pieces. Additionally, there are cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to help you dig for the necessary pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with big threats while disrupting their plans with counterspells.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to play powerful spells like Show and Tell and Omniscience. By using cards like Stock Up and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck aims to control the game until it can cast game-ending threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. The inclusion of combo pieces like Eureka and Lotus Petal allows for explosive plays that can overwhelm opponents. With a mix of powerful creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to use cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond to quickly generate mana and cast Doomsday, allowing the player to stack their deck with Thassa's Oracle and win the game on the spot. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the combo from counterspells, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help to find the necessary pieces to execute the combo efficiently.

The main concept of this Oops, All Spells! combo deck is to quickly mill your entire library into your graveyard and then win the game by casting Thassa's Oracle to instantly win the game. The deck utilizes a combination of fast mana acceleration, graveyard recursion, and protection spells to execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. By using a combination of creatures like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, along with spells like Dread Return and Reanimate, the deck aims to empty its library and win the game in just a few turns.

The main idea of this deck is to control the tempo of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and countermagic like Force of Will, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Baleful Strix. The deck aims to maintain card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, while also using removal spells like Fatal Push to clear the way for its threats. Additionally, cards like Daze and Wasteland can disrupt the opponent's mana development, further slowing down their game plan.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly put powerful creatures into play by utilizing cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. By using these cards, the player can cheat out creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield without having to pay their high mana costs. The deck also includes a good amount of card filtering and protection spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to ensure the combo can go off successfully. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game swiftly.

This UWx control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, while also utilizing removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to control the game with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler, while also setting up card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. Dress Down helps to deal with problematic creatures, while Supreme Verdict provides a board wipe option. Mystic Sanctuary allows for reusing important spells, while Stock Up helps to draw into key cards. The deck is designed to control the pace of the game and outvalue opponents.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while efficiently removing threats with Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also aims to apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Barrowgoyf, Nethergoyf, and Stalactite Stalker, supported by additional creature removal options like Dauthi Voidwalker and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck utilizes a mix of disruption, aggression, and removal to control the game and outpace the opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, allowing for early plays of powerful artifacts like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void to disrupt opponents. The deck also utilizes aggressive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Broadside Bombardiers to pressure the opponent while controlling the board with cards like Sundering Eruption and Fury. The consistency of the deck is maintained through the use of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker.
